name: AFB – Auto Form Builder with AI, Contact & Conversational Forms
author: Ali Ghasemirad

sections.description:
Support

Watch the full overview video below.

Auto Form Builder is a free drag-and-drop WordPress form builder for creating professional forms — contact forms, multi-step forms, surveys, file upload forms, and forms with conditional logic — without writing any code.

It also brings AI to your forms. With the optional AI add-ons you can build a form from a plain-English description or an uploaded document, generate conditional logic automatically, summarize and draft replies to submissions, ask across all your submissions, and use an admin AI assistant that answers questions and even creates forms. You can also turn any form into an AI conversational form that collects answers naturally.

The core builder and every non-AI feature are completely free, with no upsells hidden behind core functionality. The AI features are optional and off by default (see “External Services” for the full disclosure).

Why Auto Form Builder?

Unlike form plugins that lock their best features behind expensive subscriptions, Auto Form Builder gives you multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization — all free.

Plugin Dashboard

A command center with four KPI cards (total forms, total submissions, unread entries, and this week’s activity with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day activity chart, latest entries, a top-forms ranking, add-on status, and one-click shortcuts. New users get a guided onboarding card.

Drag & Drop Form Builder

Build a form in minutes: drag fields onto the canvas and you’re done. The builder supports undo/redo, a live preview (desktop, tablet, mobile), and instant shortcode generation to embed your form anywhere.

Embed Forms on Any Website

Every form comes with a ready-made embed code you can paste onto any website — including non-WordPress sites and page builders such as WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embedded form keeps your design, auto-resizes to fit its content, and stays isolated from the host theme. Redirect thank-you pages can even break out of the frame.

Popup Forms (Add-On)

Show any form in a popup without installing a second popup plugin. Activate the free Popups add-on and create unlimited popups in a range of styles — modal, slide-in, sticky bar, full-screen, welcome mat, and a floating launcher button. Choose exactly which pages they appear on, trigger them by time delay, scroll depth, exit intent, element clicks, and more, cap how often each popup shows, and decide what happens after a successful submission. Duplicate a popup to reuse its setup, and edit safely with an unsaved-changes warning. Popups are fully keyboard accessible and load nothing on pages without an eligible popup.

15+ Field Types

Every common field type is included:

  • Text Input
  • Textarea
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Number
  • Date & Time
  • Month & Year
  • Checkbox
  • Radio Buttons
  • Dropdown
  • Name Field
  • Address
  • File Upload
  • Signature
  • Color Picker
  • Page Break (multi-step forms)
  • Tabular Survey (Likert grid)
  • Star Rating
  • NPS (0–10)
  • Opinion Scale

Signature Field

Collect e-signatures inside your form. Visitors sign with a mouse, finger, or stylus; the signature is stored securely and shown as an image in the entry details — ideal for consent forms, agreements, and approvals, on WordPress pages and embedded forms alike.

Survey Fields & Visual Results

Build complete surveys with four dedicated question types, free:

  • Tabular Survey (Likert grid) — rows of questions with your own answer columns (radio or checkbox), collapsing neatly on mobile.
  • Star Rating — 3 to 10 stars, keyboard and touch accessible.
  • NPS (0–10) — the standard Net Promoter Score scale with Detractor/Passive/Promoter answers.
  • Opinion Scale — numbered buttons with custom end labels.

The Survey Results screen gives visual, per-question reports: distribution charts, stacked bars, an automatically calculated NPS score, and a 30-day trend. Survey answers appear formatted in entry details and CSV exports, and conditional logic works with every survey field.

Color Picker Field

Let visitors choose a color with the browser’s native picker — ideal for design requests and product personalization. The value is validated, stored, and shown as a swatch with its hex code.

Month & Year Field

Collect a month and year (or year only) without a full calendar date — useful for card expiration dates, employment start months, and graduation years. Month & Year opens an easy custom picker with year arrows and a single month grid (no endless scrolling), and Year only uses a year dropdown. Set the earliest and latest allowed month or year, or switch on “Block Future Dates” so answers can’t be later than today — ideal for questions like “When was your business established?”. Values are validated, stored in a clear format, and shown correctly in entry details and email notifications.

Pre-Built Templates

Start faster with ready-to-use templates including Contact Form, Feedback Form, Support Request, Newsletter Signup, and Event Registration. Every template is fully customizable.

Conditional Logic

Show or hide any field based on earlier answers, using multiple AND/OR conditions per field — no code required. Logic also controls confirmations and emails: show a different success message or redirect, route the admin notification elsewhere, change its subject or message, skip it, or send a different confirmation email. The first matching rule wins; otherwise your normal settings apply.

Multi-Step Forms

Break long forms into short steps to boost completion. Enable multi-step mode, drop Page Break fields where each step begins, set step titles and button labels, and pick a progress bar style. Step branching can skip steps or jump ahead based on earlier answers (forward-only and loop-safe), so every visitor sees only the steps that apply.

Partial Entries — Capture Abandoned Forms

Don’t lose a lead when someone doesn’t press Submit. With partial entry capture, in-progress answers are saved and reviewable on the Partial Entries screen. Abandoned entries auto-delete after a retention period you control (1–365 days).

Full Visual Customization

Make your forms match your brand perfectly. The Customize tab gives you control over:

  • Theme presets — Corporate, Minimal, Modern, Eco, Friendly, Luxury, Neutral, Creative, Feminine, Fresh, and more
  • Reusable saved themes — save your custom design once and apply it to any other form with a single click
  • Header image / banner per form
  • Background, colors, fonts, layout
  • Field styling and button design
  • Label icons and inside-the-field icons (see below)
  • Visual effects

Every change is previewed live across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Label Icons & Inside-the-Field Icons

Add polish to any field with icons — no code and no external icon library required. Place an icon next to a field’s label from a built-in set of 40+ icons or upload your own PNG/JPG, and add an icon inside Text, Email, Number, Phone, and URL fields (shown at the start of the input, separated by a divider). Control each icon’s color, optional background chip, and size per field. Fields without an icon stay exactly as they were.

Submission Management

All submissions live in a clean inbox with Unread, Starred, Read, Spam, and Trash tabs. Search by any field value, filter by form or date range, sort, and print — right from the dashboard.

Email Notifications

Get notified instantly on submit. Admin and user confirmation emails are fully configurable per form — recipients, subject, and a custom message with placeholders like {submission_data} and {form_name}. Choose styled HTML or plain text, and use conditional rules to send different emails (or none).

Form Analytics

Track views, submissions, average conversion rate, and per-form breakdowns with a 30-day chart. Sync historical submissions or reset data anytime. Included free and activatable from the Add-Ons page.

Spam Protection

Two options are included free — Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile — activatable from the Add-Ons page. Use one or both on any form.

User Registration & Login

Turn any form into a registration form. Map fields to the account email, username, password, and first/last name (a single Full Name field is split automatically), choose the new user’s role (never Administrator), and optionally send a custom welcome email with placeholders like {username} and {set_password_url}. Passwords are handled by WordPress core and never stored with the submission or emailed.

The add-on also provides an independent login form via the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode — sign-in, lost password, and password reset all on your own page, styled to match your site.

Import & Export

Export forms and entries for backup or migration, and import forms onto any WordPress site in seconds — ideal for agencies.

Slack Notifications

Notify your team in Slack the moment a form is submitted. Activate the free add-on, paste a Slack Incoming Webhook URL, and choose which forms post to which channels. Only hooks.slack.com URLs are accepted, no credentials are stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.

Webhooks

Send submission data to Zapier, Make, or any custom endpoint the moment a form is submitted.

Extend with Paid Add-Ons

The free plugin is complete on its own. For teams and agencies, premium add-ons are available to extend specific functionality.

Auto Form CRM Integration

Auto Form Builder integrates natively with Auto Form CRM, a dedicated WordPress CRM for managing leads and submissions in one place.

AI Features (Optional Add-Ons)

Two optional AI add-ons are available and off by default: AI Assistant (build a form from a description or document, one-click summaries and suggested replies, “ask across your submissions”, and an admin chat assistant that answers questions and creates forms) and AI Conversation (turn a form into a friendly chat, with optional appointment booking).

These features connect to AIDA, our AI service at autoformcrm.com, and stay off until you opt in. See “External Services” below for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.

External Services

Auto Form Builder is privacy-first. By default the plugin does not contact any external service. Every service below is off by default and only runs after you actively opt in.

AIDA — AI Assistant & AI Conversation (optional add-ons, off by default)

  • Service & provider: AIDA, the AI service that powers the optional AI features, by Auto Form Builder / Auto Form CRM (https://autoformcrm.com/). Requests are processed by a third-party AI provider, Anthropic.
  • When contacted: only after an administrator activates an AI add-on, connects an AIDA account, and then uses an AI feature. Otherwise nothing is ever sent, and the core form builder never contacts AIDA.
  • Account & cost: the AI features need a free AIDA account (with free trial credits); continued use afterward requires one-time credit packs from autoformcrm.com. The core plugin and all non-AI features stay free and need no account. Your credit balance is shown in the plugin, and purchases always open autoformcrm.com in a new tab (no payment inside the plugin).
  • Data sent (only for the action you trigger): the form description and any document you upload when building a form; the submission content when you request a summary, a suggested reply, or an “ask across submissions” answer, or when the admin assistant answers about your forms/submissions; the messages you type into the admin assistant; and, only if you enable AI Conversation on a public form, the chat messages visitors type. Your AIDA token is sent server-side only to authenticate, stored encrypted, and never exposed to the browser.
  • Data NOT sent: nothing for any AI feature you do not use, no form/submission content beyond the action you trigger, and never passwords handled by WordPress core.
  • Purpose: to provide AI form building, submission summaries and replies, the admin assistant, and conversational forms.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformcrm.com/terms and https://autoformcrm.com/privacy (Auto Form CRM / AIDA); Anthropic — https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy.

Anonymous Deactivation Feedback (opt-in, one-time)

  • Service & provider: Auto Form Builder feedback endpoint, https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-deactivation-feedback.php (https://autoformbuilder.com/).
  • When contacted: only when an administrator clicks “Submit & Deactivate” in the optional dialog shown on deactivation. Skipping, closing, or dismissing it sends nothing.
  • Data sent: the reason you selected, an optional explanation (max 1000 characters), your WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, and your site locale. The exact JSON payload is shown in the dialog before anything is sent.
  • Data NOT sent: site URL, administrator name or email, user ID, IP address, or any form/submission data (the request User-Agent is neutralized so it carries no site URL).
  • Purpose: to understand why users deactivate the plugin and prioritise improvements.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformbuilder.com/

Anonymous Usage Data (opt-in, off by default)

  • Service & provider: Auto Form Builder telemetry endpoint, https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-telemetry.php (https://autoformbuilder.com/).
  • When contacted: only if you enable “Help improve Auto Form Builder by sending anonymous usage data” (in onboarding or Settings → General) — then a one-time “install” event on opt-in and an “uninstall” event on deletion. Turning it off stops all further requests.
  • Data sent: a locally generated anonymous site ID (not derived from your URL), the plugin / WordPress / PHP / MySQL versions, the plugin version at install, your site locale, whether the site is multisite, days since install, approximate form and submission counts as ranges (never exact), active add-ons, and whether onboarding was completed. The full list is shown next to the opt-in checkbox.
  • Data NOT sent: site URL, administrator name or email, user ID, IP address, or any form/submission content.
  • Purpose: to measure the uninstall rate and which environments and usage levels correlate with leaving, so we can prioritise improvements.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformbuilder.com/privacy/

Slack Notifications (optional add-on, off by default)

  • Service & provider: Slack Incoming Webhooks, Slack Technologies, LLC (https://slack.com/). Only hooks.slack.com URLs are accepted; no other host is ever contacted.
  • When contacted: only after you activate the add-on, set a webhook URL you created in your own Slack workspace, and enable it for a form — then on each submission of that form and when you click “Send Test”.
  • Data sent: the form title and your site name; the values a visitor submitted only if you also enable “Include answers” for that form. Passwords, CAPTCHA values, file contents, and server file paths are never sent; uploaded files appear by filename only.
  • Purpose: to notify your team in Slack about new form submissions in real time.
  • Terms / privacy: https://slack.com/terms-of-service and https://slack.com/trust/privacy/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Auto Form Builder”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Navigate to Auto Form Builder in your admin menu
  5. Click Create New Form to build your first form
  6. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page or post
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free?

Yes. Auto Form Builder is 100% free. Multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization are all included at no cost. Optional paid add-ons are available for extended functionality.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. The drag-and-drop builder requires zero coding knowledge. Everything from building to styling to embedding is handled through the visual interface.

Can I add conditional logic to my forms?

Yes. Every field supports conditional logic. You can show or hide fields based on other field values, using AND or OR conditions, with multiple conditions per field.

What field types are available?

Text Input, Textarea, Email, Phone, Number, Date, Month & Year, Time, Checkbox, Radio Buttons, Dropdown, Name, Address, File Upload, Signature, Color Picker, Page Break (for multi-step forms), and four survey fields: Tabular Survey (Likert grid), Star Rating, NPS, and Opinion Scale.

Can I create multi-step forms?

Yes. Enable multi-step mode in Form Settings and add Page Break fields where each new step should start. You get step titles, custom Next/Previous button labels, progress bar styles, and answer-based step branching that can skip steps or jump ahead so visitors only see what applies to them.

Can I see answers from visitors who never finished the form?

Yes. Turn on partial entry capture and in-progress answers are saved while visitors fill out the form. Review them on the Partial Entries screen, and let abandoned entries auto-delete after a retention period you choose (1–365 days).

Can I get Slack notifications for form submissions?

Yes. Activate the free Slack Notifications add-on, paste your Slack Incoming Webhook URL, and enable it for any form. Different forms can notify different Slack channels, and you choose per form whether the submitted answers are included in the message.

Can I embed my form on another website?

Yes. Every form comes with a ready-made embed code — click “Copy embed code” on the Forms screen and paste it into any website, including non-WordPress sites and page builders like WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embedded form keeps your original design, resizes automatically to fit its content, and stays isolated from the host site’s styles. You can also copy a direct link to the form and share it as its own page.

Can I show my form in a popup?

Yes. Activate the free Popups add-on and display any form in a popup — modal, slide-in, sticky bar, full-screen, welcome mat, or a floating launcher button — without installing a separate popup plugin. You control which pages each popup appears on, how it is triggered (time delay, scroll depth, exit intent, element click, and more), how often it shows, and what happens after a successful submission.

Can I add an icon to a field label or inside a field?

Yes. You can add an icon next to any field’s label from a built-in library of 40+ icons or by uploading your own PNG/JPG, and place an icon inside Text, Email, Number, Phone, and URL fields. Each icon’s color, background chip, and size are adjustable per field.

Can I reuse the same design across multiple forms?

Yes. Design a form in the Customize tab, save it as a theme, and apply that saved theme to any other form with one click — so all your forms share a consistent, on-brand look without redoing the styling each time.

Can visitors sign my forms with an e-signature?

Yes. Add the Signature field and visitors can draw their signature with a mouse, finger, or stylus. The signature is stored securely with the submission and shown as an image in the entry details — on your WordPress pages and in embedded forms.

Can users register and log in through my forms?

Yes. Activate the free User Registration & Login add-on, pick which form creates accounts, and map its fields to the account email, username, password, and name. You can choose the role new users receive, customize the welcome email, and add a fully independent login form to any page with the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode — including lost password and password reset, all without the default WordPress login screen.

Can I protect my forms from spam?

Yes. Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile are both included as free built-in add-ons. Activate either or both from the Add-Ons page.

Can I track form performance?

Yes. The built-in Form Analytics add-on tracks views, submissions, and conversion rates per form with a 30-day activity chart.

Can I export form submissions?

Yes. You can export forms and entries from the Settings > Import/Export tab.

Does it support webhooks?

Yes. Built-in webhook support lets you send submission data to Zapier, Make, or any external endpoint.

Do the AI features cost money?

The core form builder is free and always will be — you never need an account for it. The optional AI features (the AI Assistant and AI Conversation add-ons) run on our AIDA service. Creating an AIDA account is free and comes with free trial credits; once those are used up, continued AI usage requires purchasing one-time credit packs on autoformcrm.com. So AI is a paid service after the free trial, while everything else in the plugin stays free. Your credit balance is always visible in the plugin.

What data is sent to external services when I use the AI features?

Only when you actually use an AI feature, and only the content that feature needs: the form description or uploaded document when building a form; the submission content when you summarize, reply, or “ask across submissions”, or when the admin assistant answers a question; the messages you type into the admin assistant; and — only if you enable AI Conversation on a public form — the chat messages that site visitors type into that form. Requests are authenticated with your AIDA account token (kept encrypted on your server) and processed by our AI provider, Anthropic. Nothing is sent unless you opt in and use the feature. See the “External Services” section above for the full disclosure.

Can I use the plugin without the AI features?

Yes. Auto Form Builder is fully functional without any AI. The AI add-ons are optional and off by default — nothing is sent anywhere unless you activate an AI add-on and connect an AIDA account. If you never opt in, the plugin never contacts AIDA, and every non-AI feature works exactly as before.

Where can I get support?

Visit autoformbuilder.com/support for documentation and support.
sections.changelog:
1.4.3

  • New: Month & Year field — collect month/year with an easy custom picker (year arrows and a single month grid), or year only with a year dropdown. Works with conditional logic, entry details, admin/user email notifications, URL prefill, AI form builder defaults, and AI Conversation forms. Existing Date fields are unchanged.
  • New: “Block Future Dates” option for the Month & Year field, so answers cannot be later than the current month or year — ideal for questions like “When was your business established?”. Combine it with the Earliest Month/Year setting to bound both ends.
  • New: Save your Customize design as a reusable theme, then apply it to your other forms with one click. Saved themes live in the Customize → Theme panel; existing forms and themes are unchanged.
  • New: Label icons — add an icon next to any field label from a built-in library of 40+ icons, or upload your own PNG/JPG. Control the icon color, optional background chip, and size per field. Fields without an icon are completely unchanged.
  • New: Inside-the-field icons — show an icon at the start of Text, Email, Number, Phone and URL fields, separated from the value by a divider. Choose a built-in icon or a PNG/JPG and set its color, background and size. Fields without an icon are completely unchanged.
  • New: Popups add-on — show any form in a popup without installing a second plugin. Create unlimited popups (modal, slide-in, sticky bar, full-screen, welcome mat, floating launcher), pick the pages they appear on, trigger them by time, scroll, exit intent, clicks and more, cap how often they show, and choose what happens after a successful submission. Fully keyboard accessible, loads nothing on pages without an eligible popup.
  • Improved: The Popups add-on editor now warns you about unsaved changes before you close it or leave the page, so popup edits are no longer lost by accident.

1.4.2

  • Fixed: Name field with separate parts now labels each part correctly (e.g. “First Name” and “Last Name”) in the submission details, email notifications, and stored entries, instead of showing “Name” twice.
  • Fixed: When only First Name and/or Last Name are marked required, the required asterisk now appears next to those parts.
  • Fixed: The required asterisk no longer appears on every individual radio button or checkbox option — it now shows only on the field’s own label.

1.4.1

  • New: URL prefill for individual Name and Address components — First, Middle, Last and Suffix, plus Company/Organization, Address Line 1 and 2, City, State/Province/Region and ZIP/Postal Code can each read their own URL parameter, so composite fields can be pre-populated from a link without workarounds.
  • New: AI Assistant and AI Conversation are now active by default on fresh installs, and are enabled once on upgrade for existing sites. If you deactivate either add-on it stays off.
  • New: “Build with AI” now always appears in the “Create a new form” dialog. When the AI Assistant add-on is inactive it guides you to activate it, and when it is active but not yet connected it guides you to connect AIDA.
  • New: Dismissible dashboard and Add-Ons prompts that walk you through activating the free AI add-ons and then connecting AIDA, so the AI features are easy to discover.
  • New: Export / Import button on the Submissions and Partial Entries screens that links straight to the CSV export and import tools.
  • Fixed: URL-prefilled dropdowns (including searchable dropdowns) now fire the same change event as a manual selection, so conditional logic evaluates on page load and dependent fields show or hide correctly.

1.4.0

Released: 2026-08-06.

  • New: AI Assistant add-on (optional, off by default) — connect a free AIDA account to bring AI to your forms:
    • Build a form with AI from a plain-English description.
    • Document-to-form — upload a document and turn it into a ready-to-edit form.
    • Automatic conditional logic generation as part of AI form building.
    • One-click submission summaries and AI-drafted replies.
    • “Ask across your submissions” — answer questions spanning all entries of a form.
    • Admin AI chat assistant — a built-in assistant that answers questions about your forms and submissions and can create new forms for you.
  • New: AI Conversation add-on (now built-in, optional, off by default) — turn any form into a friendly conversational form: an AI chat that collects answers naturally, with optional appointment booking via Auto Form CRM.
  • New: AIDA credits — a single shared credit balance that powers both AI add-ons, always visible in the plugin. New accounts start with free trial credits; afterward, top up with one-time credit packs purchased on autoformcrm.com in a new tab (no payment ever happens inside the plugin). See the AIDA entry in the “External Services” section of this readme for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.
  • Note: The core drag-and-drop form builder and all non-AI features remain completely free and never require an account. The AI features are opt-in and connect to AIDA only after you activate an AI add-on.

1.3.1

  • New: Per-component Required checkboxes on the Address field for Address Line 2, State/Province/Region, ZIP/Postal Code, Country, and Company/Organization — each appears under its component in Advanced Settings and can be toggled independently.
  • Improved: Marking the Address field itself Required now automatically requires the two always-rendered core components (Address Line 1 and City), so a required address can no longer be submitted empty.
  • Improved: Address country component — when the country is shown and Required, no default country is silently preselected (visitors must choose explicitly), and Hide Country never bypasses a shown, required country.
  • Improved: Address renderer skips the Required flag for any component that is hidden, so a “required” toggle on a disabled component never blocks submission.
  • Fixed: Conditional logic now works in every copy of a form on the page, including page-builder popups (Brizy, Elementor, WP Bakery, etc.) that clone or lazy-inject form markup — the manager tracks every DOM instance and listens at the document capture phase so overlays that stop event propagation cannot silence it.
  • Fixed: Multi-step forms now correctly hide inactive steps even when a site serves a stale cached stylesheet — steps are hidden inline in addition to via CSS.
  • Fixed: Required Name field with “Separate fields (First name, Last name)” enabled now validates the subfield values correctly and no longer reports the field as missing when it was filled in.
  • Fixed: Required Address field now validates the submitted address components correctly and no longer reports the field as missing when it was filled in.
  • Fixed: Required radio groups are enforced even when a page builder strips the native required attribute from the inputs (via a container-level flag), so radio validation keeps working inside popups.
  • Fixed: Address subfield validation preserves the camelCase keys addressLine1 / addressLine2 so per-component labels and Required rules resolve correctly on submit.
  • Improved: conditional-logic.js and multistep.js are now versioned by file modification time, so browser and CDN caches automatically pick up future frontend script fixes without requiring a full plugin version bump.

1.3

  • New: Redesigned plugin dashboard — personalized hero header, four KPI cards (forms, submissions, unread, and this week with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day submission activity chart, recent entries, top-performing-forms ranking, built-in add-on status, quick actions, and a guided onboarding card when no forms exist yet.
  • New: Multi-step forms — enable in Form Settings and split any form with Page Break fields, with step titles, custom Next/Previous button labels, and multiple progress bar styles.
  • New: Step branching — skip a step or jump ahead based on earlier answers (forward-only, loop-safe), so every visitor only sees the steps that apply to them.
  • New: Partial entry capture — optionally save in-progress answers, review them under Partial Entries, and auto-delete abandoned entries after a configurable retention period (1–365 days).
  • New: Slack Notifications add-on — post a message to a Slack channel the moment a form is submitted, using Slack Incoming Webhooks. Enable notifications per form, send different forms to different channels, choose per form whether the submitted answers are included, and verify your setup with a one-click test message. Only hooks.slack.com webhook URLs are accepted, no Slack credentials are stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.
  • Improved: Survey field answers in notification emails — ratings and scales show as score/max with end labels, and matrix answers list each question clearly (no NPS segment labels in confirmation emails).
  • Fixed: Duplicating a form now regenerates field IDs and remaps conditional logic, branching, settings, and email merge tags, so copies never collide with the original on the same page.
  • Fixed: Checkbox/radio, email, and searchable dropdown handlers work correctly when the same form is rendered more than once (e.g. page + popup).
  • Fixed: Conditionally hidden fields stay hidden even when a site serves a stale cached stylesheet.
  • Fixed: Required checkbox groups are validated correctly on the frontend.

1.2.9

  • New: Survey field types — a new “Survey” category in the form builder with four field types, all free: Tabular Survey (a rows × columns Likert grid with an optional multiple-answers-per-row mode that collapses neatly on mobile), Star Rating (3–10 stars, keyboard accessible), NPS (the standard 0–10 Net Promoter Score scale with color-coded answers), and Opinion Scale (numbered 0/1–10 buttons with custom labels for each end).
  • New: Survey Results page — a new admin screen with visual, per-question results: answer distribution charts for ratings and scales, stacked bar charts for tabular surveys, option counts for radio/dropdown/checkbox questions, an automatic NPS score with the Promoter/Passive/Detractor breakdown, and a 30-day response trend.
  • New: Survey answers are shown in a readable format in the entry details (stars, NPS segment badges, per-question matrix answers) and CSV exports now write structured answers as readable text instead of raw code.
  • New: Conditional logic works with all survey fields — for example, show a “What can we improve?” question only when the NPS score is 6 or less. Rules on a tabular survey match any row’s answer, and the rule editor now shows guidance (valid ranges, tips) when a survey field is selected.
  • Improved: Survey fields follow the form’s Customize colors — scale buttons, matrix answers, and focus outlines use the form’s primary color instead of a fixed blue.
  • Fixed: Star rating and tabular survey accessibility labels could appear as visible text on themes without screen-reader styles; the plugin now ships its own.
  • Fixed: Form Analytics add-on charts load again — the Chart.js library it relies on is now shipped with the plugin.

1.2.8

  • New: Gutenberg block — insert any form directly from the block editor. Pick the form from a dropdown and see a live, styled preview right in the editor; the block always renders the latest version of the form, so no shortcodes are needed.
  • New: WordPress dashboard widget — see your forms, total and unread submissions, and this week’s activity at a glance on the main WordPress dashboard, with a 7-day submissions chart, the latest entries (unread highlighted), and one-click shortcuts to create a form or open submissions.
  • New: Prefill from URL parameters — enable “Prefill from URL Parameter” on text, email, phone, number, dropdown, and radio fields to fill them automatically from links like ?business-name=Acme. Also works for forms embedded on other websites: the host page’s URL parameters are forwarded to the embedded form securely.

short_description: Drag & drop AI form builder for WordPress. Build forms with AI, add conversational forms & an AI assistant, embed anywhere. Free core builder.
description:
Support

Watch the full overview video below.

Auto Form Builder is a free drag-and-drop WordPress form builder for creating professional forms — contact forms, multi-step forms, surveys, file upload forms, and forms with conditional logic — without writing any code.

It also brings AI to your forms. With the optional AI add-ons you can build a form from a plain-English description or an uploaded document, generate conditional logic automatically, summarize and draft replies to submissions, ask across all your submissions, and use an admin AI assistant that answers questions and even creates forms. You can also turn any form into an AI conversational form that collects answers naturally.

The core builder and every non-AI feature are completely free, with no upsells hidden behind core functionality. The AI features are optional and off by default (see “External Services” for the full disclosure).

Why Auto Form Builder?

Unlike form plugins that lock their best features behind expensive subscriptions, Auto Form Builder gives you multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization — all free.

Plugin Dashboard

A command center with four KPI cards (total forms, total submissions, unread entries, and this week’s activity with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day activity chart, latest entries, a top-forms ranking, add-on status, and one-click shortcuts. New users get a guided onboarding card.

Drag & Drop Form Builder

Build a form in minutes: drag fields onto the canvas and you’re done. The builder supports undo/redo, a live preview (desktop, tablet, mobile), and instant shortcode generation to embed your form anywhere.

Embed Forms on Any Website

Every form comes with a ready-made embed code you can paste onto any website — including non-WordPress sites and page builders such as WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embedded form keeps your design, auto-resizes to fit its content, and stays isolated from the host theme. Redirect thank-you pages can even break out of the frame.

Popup Forms (Add-On)

Show any form in a popup without installing a second popup plugin. Activate the free Popups add-on and create unlimited popups in a range of styles — modal, slide-in, sticky bar, full-screen, welcome mat, and a floating launcher button. Choose exactly which pages they appear on, trigger them by time delay, scroll depth, exit intent, element clicks, and more, cap how often each popup shows, and decide what happens after a successful submission. Duplicate a popup to reuse its setup, and edit safely with an unsaved-changes warning. Popups are fully keyboard accessible and load nothing on pages without an eligible popup.

15+ Field Types

Every common field type is included:

  • Text Input
  • Textarea
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Number
  • Date & Time
  • Month & Year
  • Checkbox
  • Radio Buttons
  • Dropdown
  • Name Field
  • Address
  • File Upload
  • Signature
  • Color Picker
  • Page Break (multi-step forms)
  • Tabular Survey (Likert grid)
  • Star Rating
  • NPS (0–10)
  • Opinion Scale

Signature Field

Collect e-signatures inside your form. Visitors sign with a mouse, finger, or stylus; the signature is stored securely and shown as an image in the entry details — ideal for consent forms, agreements, and approvals, on WordPress pages and embedded forms alike.

Survey Fields & Visual Results

Build complete surveys with four dedicated question types, free:

  • Tabular Survey (Likert grid) — rows of questions with your own answer columns (radio or checkbox), collapsing neatly on mobile.
  • Star Rating — 3 to 10 stars, keyboard and touch accessible.
  • NPS (0–10) — the standard Net Promoter Score scale with Detractor/Passive/Promoter answers.
  • Opinion Scale — numbered buttons with custom end labels.

The Survey Results screen gives visual, per-question reports: distribution charts, stacked bars, an automatically calculated NPS score, and a 30-day trend. Survey answers appear formatted in entry details and CSV exports, and conditional logic works with every survey field.

Color Picker Field

Let visitors choose a color with the browser’s native picker — ideal for design requests and product personalization. The value is validated, stored, and shown as a swatch with its hex code.

Month & Year Field

Collect a month and year (or year only) without a full calendar date — useful for card expiration dates, employment start months, and graduation years. Month & Year opens an easy custom picker with year arrows and a single month grid (no endless scrolling), and Year only uses a year dropdown. Set the earliest and latest allowed month or year, or switch on “Block Future Dates” so answers can’t be later than today — ideal for questions like “When was your business established?”. Values are validated, stored in a clear format, and shown correctly in entry details and email notifications.

Pre-Built Templates

Start faster with ready-to-use templates including Contact Form, Feedback Form, Support Request, Newsletter Signup, and Event Registration. Every template is fully customizable.

Conditional Logic

Show or hide any field based on earlier answers, using multiple AND/OR conditions per field — no code required. Logic also controls confirmations and emails: show a different success message or redirect, route the admin notification elsewhere, change its subject or message, skip it, or send a different confirmation email. The first matching rule wins; otherwise your normal settings apply.

Multi-Step Forms

Break long forms into short steps to boost completion. Enable multi-step mode, drop Page Break fields where each step begins, set step titles and button labels, and pick a progress bar style. Step branching can skip steps or jump ahead based on earlier answers (forward-only and loop-safe), so every visitor sees only the steps that apply.

Partial Entries — Capture Abandoned Forms

Don’t lose a lead when someone doesn’t press Submit. With partial entry capture, in-progress answers are saved and reviewable on the Partial Entries screen. Abandoned entries auto-delete after a retention period you control (1–365 days).

Full Visual Customization

Make your forms match your brand perfectly. The Customize tab gives you control over:

  • Theme presets — Corporate, Minimal, Modern, Eco, Friendly, Luxury, Neutral, Creative, Feminine, Fresh, and more
  • Reusable saved themes — save your custom design once and apply it to any other form with a single click
  • Header image / banner per form
  • Background, colors, fonts, layout
  • Field styling and button design
  • Label icons and inside-the-field icons (see below)
  • Visual effects

Every change is previewed live across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Label Icons & Inside-the-Field Icons

Add polish to any field with icons — no code and no external icon library required. Place an icon next to a field’s label from a built-in set of 40+ icons or upload your own PNG/JPG, and add an icon inside Text, Email, Number, Phone, and URL fields (shown at the start of the input, separated by a divider). Control each icon’s color, optional background chip, and size per field. Fields without an icon stay exactly as they were.

Submission Management

All submissions live in a clean inbox with Unread, Starred, Read, Spam, and Trash tabs. Search by any field value, filter by form or date range, sort, and print — right from the dashboard.

Email Notifications

Get notified instantly on submit. Admin and user confirmation emails are fully configurable per form — recipients, subject, and a custom message with placeholders like {submission_data} and {form_name}. Choose styled HTML or plain text, and use conditional rules to send different emails (or none).

Form Analytics

Track views, submissions, average conversion rate, and per-form breakdowns with a 30-day chart. Sync historical submissions or reset data anytime. Included free and activatable from the Add-Ons page.

Spam Protection

Two options are included free — Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile — activatable from the Add-Ons page. Use one or both on any form.

User Registration & Login

Turn any form into a registration form. Map fields to the account email, username, password, and first/last name (a single Full Name field is split automatically), choose the new user’s role (never Administrator), and optionally send a custom welcome email with placeholders like {username} and {set_password_url}. Passwords are handled by WordPress core and never stored with the submission or emailed.

The add-on also provides an independent login form via the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode — sign-in, lost password, and password reset all on your own page, styled to match your site.

Import & Export

Export forms and entries for backup or migration, and import forms onto any WordPress site in seconds — ideal for agencies.

Slack Notifications

Notify your team in Slack the moment a form is submitted. Activate the free add-on, paste a Slack Incoming Webhook URL, and choose which forms post to which channels. Only hooks.slack.com URLs are accepted, no credentials are stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.

Webhooks

Send submission data to Zapier, Make, or any custom endpoint the moment a form is submitted.

Extend with Paid Add-Ons

The free plugin is complete on its own. For teams and agencies, premium add-ons are available to extend specific functionality.

Auto Form CRM Integration

Auto Form Builder integrates natively with Auto Form CRM, a dedicated WordPress CRM for managing leads and submissions in one place.

AI Features (Optional Add-Ons)

Two optional AI add-ons are available and off by default: AI Assistant (build a form from a description or document, one-click summaries and suggested replies, “ask across your submissions”, and an admin chat assistant that answers questions and creates forms) and AI Conversation (turn a form into a friendly chat, with optional appointment booking).

These features connect to AIDA, our AI service at autoformcrm.com, and stay off until you opt in. See “External Services” below for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.

External Services

Auto Form Builder is privacy-first. By default the plugin does not contact any external service. Every service below is off by default and only runs after you actively opt in.

AIDA — AI Assistant & AI Conversation (optional add-ons, off by default)

  • Service & provider: AIDA, the AI service that powers the optional AI features, by Auto Form Builder / Auto Form CRM (https://autoformcrm.com/). Requests are processed by a third-party AI provider, Anthropic.
  • When contacted: only after an administrator activates an AI add-on, connects an AIDA account, and then uses an AI feature. Otherwise nothing is ever sent, and the core form builder never contacts AIDA.
  • Account & cost: the AI features need a free AIDA account (with free trial credits); continued use afterward requires one-time credit packs from autoformcrm.com. The core plugin and all non-AI features stay free and need no account. Your credit balance is shown in the plugin, and purchases always open autoformcrm.com in a new tab (no payment inside the plugin).
  • Data sent (only for the action you trigger): the form description and any document you upload when building a form; the submission content when you request a summary, a suggested reply, or an “ask across submissions” answer, or when the admin assistant answers about your forms/submissions; the messages you type into the admin assistant; and, only if you enable AI Conversation on a public form, the chat messages visitors type. Your AIDA token is sent server-side only to authenticate, stored encrypted, and never exposed to the browser.
  • Data NOT sent: nothing for any AI feature you do not use, no form/submission content beyond the action you trigger, and never passwords handled by WordPress core.
  • Purpose: to provide AI form building, submission summaries and replies, the admin assistant, and conversational forms.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformcrm.com/terms and https://autoformcrm.com/privacy (Auto Form CRM / AIDA); Anthropic — https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy.

Anonymous Deactivation Feedback (opt-in, one-time)

  • Service & provider: Auto Form Builder feedback endpoint, https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-deactivation-feedback.php (https://autoformbuilder.com/).
  • When contacted: only when an administrator clicks “Submit & Deactivate” in the optional dialog shown on deactivation. Skipping, closing, or dismissing it sends nothing.
  • Data sent: the reason you selected, an optional explanation (max 1000 characters), your WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, and your site locale. The exact JSON payload is shown in the dialog before anything is sent.
  • Data NOT sent: site URL, administrator name or email, user ID, IP address, or any form/submission data (the request User-Agent is neutralized so it carries no site URL).
  • Purpose: to understand why users deactivate the plugin and prioritise improvements.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformbuilder.com/

Anonymous Usage Data (opt-in, off by default)

  • Service & provider: Auto Form Builder telemetry endpoint, https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-telemetry.php (https://autoformbuilder.com/).
  • When contacted: only if you enable “Help improve Auto Form Builder by sending anonymous usage data” (in onboarding or Settings → General) — then a one-time “install” event on opt-in and an “uninstall” event on deletion. Turning it off stops all further requests.
  • Data sent: a locally generated anonymous site ID (not derived from your URL), the plugin / WordPress / PHP / MySQL versions, the plugin version at install, your site locale, whether the site is multisite, days since install, approximate form and submission counts as ranges (never exact), active add-ons, and whether onboarding was completed. The full list is shown next to the opt-in checkbox.
  • Data NOT sent: site URL, administrator name or email, user ID, IP address, or any form/submission content.
  • Purpose: to measure the uninstall rate and which environments and usage levels correlate with leaving, so we can prioritise improvements.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformbuilder.com/privacy/

Slack Notifications (optional add-on, off by default)

  • Service & provider: Slack Incoming Webhooks, Slack Technologies, LLC (https://slack.com/). Only hooks.slack.com URLs are accepted; no other host is ever contacted.
  • When contacted: only after you activate the add-on, set a webhook URL you created in your own Slack workspace, and enable it for a form — then on each submission of that form and when you click “Send Test”.
  • Data sent: the form title and your site name; the values a visitor submitted only if you also enable “Include answers” for that form. Passwords, CAPTCHA values, file contents, and server file paths are never sent; uploaded files appear by filename only.
  • Purpose: to notify your team in Slack about new form submissions in real time.
  • Terms / privacy: https://slack.com/terms-of-service and https://slack.com/trust/privacy/privacy-policy

The Popups editor now warns before you discard unsaved changes. Existing forms and Date fields are unchanged. Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.3.1: Adds per-component Required checkboxes on the Address field (Address Line 2, State/Province/Region, ZIP/Postal, Country, Organization). Fixes conditional logic inside page-builder popups (Brizy, Elementor, WP Bakery) by supporting multiple copies of the same form on one page, fixes multi-step forms showing every step at once when a stale stylesheet is served, and fixes required Name (separate fields) and Address validation so filled-in fields are no longer reported as missing. Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.3: Adds a redesigned plugin dashboard with KPI cards, a 14-day activity chart, recent submissions, top-performing forms, and add-on status, plus multi-step forms with Page Break fields, answer-based step branching, partial entry capture with configurable retention, and a free Slack Notifications add-on with per-form channels and a one-click test message. Also improves survey answers in emails and fixes form duplication, repeated form rendering, and checkbox validation. Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.2.9: Adds a full free survey toolkit: Tabular Survey (Likert grid), Star Rating, NPS and Opinion Scale fields, plus a visual Survey Results page with charts and an automatic NPS score. Also fixes the Form Analytics add-on charts. Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.2.8: Adds a Gutenberg block for inserting forms with a live editor preview, a WordPress dashboard widget with submission stats and shortcuts, prefilling fields from URL parameters (including embedded forms), and a new Color Picker field. Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.2.7: Adds the free User Registration & Login add-on: create WordPress accounts from form submissions with field mapping, a custom welcome email, and a fully independent login form (sign in, lost password, and reset all on your own page). Also fixes submission actions for redirect-only forms. Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.2.6: Adds conditional thank-you messages/redirects and conditional email rules based on the visitor's answers, a plain-text email format option, and a custom message field for admin notifications. Existing forms behave exactly as before until you use the new options. Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.2.5: Adds a Signature field so visitors can sign forms (mouse, touch or stylus); signatures are stored with the submission and shown in the entry details. Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.2.4: Adds cross-site embedding — copy an embed code and place any form on any website, even non-WordPress sites and page builders, with the original design and automatic resizing. Includes an optional "break out of iframe" setting for redirect thank-you pages. Recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.1.2.3: Adds inline validation for searchable dropdowns and pattern/format fields (with auto-scroll to the first invalid field), plus an optional, off-by-default anonymous Usage Data setting. Recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.1.2.2: Prevents duplicate submissions from rapid clicks. Adds per-form email color branding, an optional privacy-policy link inside Single Checkbox fields, an SMTP deliverability tip, and a fully opt-in, anonymous deactivation feedback dialog (no personal data is sent).
upgrade_notice.1.2.1: Important fixes for two production-impacting bugs: form submissions no longer redirect to wp-admin login on pages with non-Latin URLs (Georgian, Arabic, Cyrillic, Chinese, Hebrew, Persian, Thai, etc.), and required-field validation now works correctly when a file upload field is on the form. Also fixes conditional logic on dropdowns, multi-select chip remove, FOUC on conditionally-hidden fields, and adds Move Up / Move Down buttons on form fields plus a new Report a Bug admin page. Strongly recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.1.2.0: Date fields now display in your configured format (DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, etc.) across the dashboard, admin emails, and user confirmation emails. Required consent/privacy checkboxes now use native inline validation instead of a full error banner, so users no longer lose typed data when they miss a required checkbox. Adds optional date preview chip toggle. Recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.1.1.9: Fixes conditional logic for multi-select dropdowns and required field validation for conditionally hidden fields. Recommended update for all users using conditional logic.
upgrade_notice.1.1.8: 8 new industry form themes, all 12 existing themes redesigned with richer visuals, hover effects, and animations. Fixes Elementor compatibility for padding, layout, and button styles. Theme switching architecture fixed. Recommended update for all users. Fixes form display issues on Hello Elementor and minimal themes.
upgrade_notice.1.1.7: New: Outbound webhooks for CRM integrations, form border and shadow controls, background opacity, header overlay with hover, help text color, name field side-by-side layout. Multiple styling fixes for header images, submit buttons, and dynamic CSS delivery. Recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.1.1.6: Fixes form display issues on Hello Elementor and minimal themes, admin page styling flash, and incorrect CAPTCHA notices. Recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.1.1.5: Critical fix: Submissions now appear correctly on the Submissions page. All status tabs work as expected. Update immediately.
upgrade_notice.1.1.4: New button customization options (border, helper text, hover text color), 15 additional Google Fonts, Google Fonts now load correctly, unified save UX, form duplication fix, and submissions page improvements.
upgrade_notice.1.1.3: Time field improvements: custom dropdown picker now fully enforces time intervals, min/max range, and 12h/24h format. Removed unused Show Seconds option. Code cleanup.
upgrade_notice.1.1.2: Bug fixes for background customization: all background types, patterns, opacity, and image controls now work correctly on both preview and frontend rendered forms.
upgrade_notice.1.1.1: New features: Customize Form styling panel, Form Analytics, reCAPTCHA Protection, and Cloudflare Turnstile add-ons. Activate add-ons from the Add-Ons page.
upgrade_notice.1.1.0: Critical fix: Resolves CSS conflicts with WooCommerce and other plugins. Highly recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.1.0.9: New feature: Send confirmation emails to users after form submission! Configure in Form Settings.
upgrade_notice.1.0.8: Customize your submit button text! Change the default "Submit" to any text you want.
upgrade_notice.1.0.7: Adds support for premium add-ons (Entry Tags, Google Sheets). Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.0.6: Fixes CSS conflicts. Recommended for all Auto Form Builder users.
upgrade_notice.1.0.4: New form templates! Create Contact, Feedback, Support, Newsletter, and Event Registration forms instantly.
upgrade_notice.1.0.0: Welcome to Auto Form Builder! Create your first form in minutes.
